definitions.gloss: income and expenses; revenue and expenditure; balance
definitions.explanation: the combined consideration of money coming in (income) and money going out (expenses); used to discuss financial balance

examples.japanese: {収支|しゅうし}のバランスを{取|と}る。
{今月|こんげつ}の{収支|しゅうし}は{赤字|あかじ}だった。
examples.english: This month's balance was in the red.

examples.japanese: {家計|かけい}の{収支|しゅうし}を{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: I'm keeping a record of our household income and expenses.

notes:
FORMS:
{収|しゅう} (income, taking in) + {支|し} (expenditure, paying out) → income and outflow

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {収支|しゅうし}が{合|あ}う (to break even)
- {収支|しゅうし}トントン (breaking even, neither profit nor loss)
- {収支|しゅうし}{報告|ほうこく} (financial report)
- {収支|しゅうし}{決算|けっさん} (balance of accounts)

TYPES:
- {年間|ねんかん}{収支|しゅうし} (annual balance)
- {月間|げっかん}{収支|しゅうし} (monthly balance)
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{収支|しゅうし} (trade balance)
- {経常|けいじょう}{収支|しゅうし} (current account balance)

RELATED WORDS:
- {収入|しゅうにゅう} (income)
- {支出|ししゅつ} (expenditure)
- {黒字|くろじ} (profit, in the black)
- {赤字|あかじ} (deficit, in the red)
